title: fix(qa): approver-resolution-matrix gains the platform_admin variant (main red since #34300)
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

No card: this is a main-red stopgap ordered by the objectstack PM seat (seat post #34366), not a card dispatch, so this PR closes no issue.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:平台测试清单 `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` 补上 `platform_admin` 审批人类型这一行,条目修订号 9→10,枚举计数 10→11,并补一条历史记录。
- 为什么改:上一个合入的 PR 给 `ApproverType` 新增了 `platform_admin`,清单没跟上,`pnpm check:platform-checklist` 在 main 上报 VARIANTS STALE 退出 1,挡住所有 PR 的 Lint & Repo Gates。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 QA 清单 JSON 文件,不发布任何包、不改运行时;回滚即撤这个 PR。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` 中该条目的 `variants`、`enumSource.expect` 和最后一条 `history`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期退出 0,末行为 `check-platform-checklist: OK`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ApproverType` (`packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts`) gained an 11th member, `platform_admin`, in commit 27c0b206. The checklist item `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix` pins that enum with `enumSource`, so the gate went red on `main` with `VARIANTS STALE`. This PR does what the gate prescribes, and nothing else:

- `variants` gains `platform_admin`, described from the merged spec docblock only: the deployment's platform administrators, asked per caller and never enumerated; it takes no value; it is accepted only in a flow shipped by a code-registered package; and designers never offer it.
- `revision` 9 to 10, with a `history` row saying what changed and that no clause changed.
- `enumSource.expect` 10 to 11.
- `source[0]` recounts the enum at 11 members (it said 10).

One file, +10 / -4. `coverage.json` needs no change: the item is already mapped there and the gate does not ask for a row.

## Tests

No code or test changed; the evidence is the gate itself. `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only `docs/qa/**`, which no package's `files[]` ships.

## Acceptance notes

- The matrix is brought level with the enum only. No step or acceptance leg for `platform_admin` is authored in this revision, so `acceptance[0]`'s per-variant clause has no driven leg for the new variant yet. Authoring that leg is a `checklist-author` pass, outside a main-red stopgap.
